translations.idiomatic: I will ascend, I will offer; rams and oxen."

sentences.zh: 據此，則備大牢之祭。

translations.literal: According to this, the great offering of ox, sheep, and pig was prepared.
translations.idiomatic: According to this, the great offering of ox, sheep, and pig was prepared.

sentences.zh: 今雲一犢，恐與古殊。

translations.literal: Now it says one bull; I fear this differs from antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: Now it says one bull; I fear this differs from antiquity.

sentences.zh: 自晉以前，未有鴟尾，其門牆璧水，一依本圖。

translations.literal: Before Jin there were no owl-tail ornaments; the gate walls and jade ring water all followed the original diagram.
translations.idiomatic: Before Jin there were no owl-tail ornaments; the gate walls and jade ring water all followed the original diagram.

sentences.zh: 晉《起居注》裴頠議曰：「尊祖配天，其義明著，廟宇之制，理據未分。

translations.literal: The Jin Daily Records, Pei Yan's memorial, states: "Honoring the ancestor with Heaven, the principle is clear; the form of the temple precincts lacks settled evidence.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin Daily Records, Pei Yan's memorial, states: "Honoring the ancestor with Heaven, the principle is clear; the form of the temple precincts lacks settled evidence.

sentences.zh: 直可為一殿以崇嚴祀，其餘雜碎，一皆除之。」

translations.literal: One hall alone may be built to solemnize sacrifice; all other miscellaneous features should be removed."
translations.idiomatic: One hall alone may be built to solemnize sacrifice; all other miscellaneous features should be removed."

sentences.zh: 臣愷案：「天垂象，聖人則之。」

translations.literal: Your subject Kai notes: "Heaven displays signs and the sage takes them as model."
translations.idiomatic: Your subject Kai notes: "Heaven displays signs and the sage takes them as model."

sentences.zh: 辟雍之星，既有圖狀，晉室方構，不合天文。

translations.literal: The star of the Jade Ring already has a diagram; the Jin court's new construction did not accord with celestial patterns.
translations.idiomatic: The star of the Jade Ring already has a diagram; the Jin court's new construction did not accord with celestial patterns.

sentences.zh: 既闕重樓，又無璧水，空堂乖五室之義，直殿違九階之文。

translations.literal: Lacking double towers and also lacking jade-ring water, an empty hall violated the meaning of five chambers, and a straight hall violated the text of nine steps.
translations.idiomatic: Lacking double towers and also lacking jade-ring water, an empty hall violated the meaning of five chambers, and a straight hall violated the text of nine steps.

sentences.zh: 非古欺天，一何過甚！

translations.literal: Deceiving Heaven by abandoning antiquity—how excessive the fault!
translations.idiomatic: Deceiving Heaven by abandoning antiquity—how excessive the fault!

sentences.zh: 後魏於北台城南，造圓牆，在璧水外，門在水內迥立，不與牆相連。

translations.literal: Later Wei south of Beitai city built a round wall outside the jade ring; the gate stood within the water apart from the wall, not connected to it.
translations.idiomatic: Later Wei south of Beitai city built a round wall outside the jade ring; the gate stood within the water apart from the wall, not connected to it.

sentences.zh: 其堂上九室，三三相重，不依古制。

translations.literal: Above the hall were nine chambers in groups of three, not following ancient form.
translations.idiomatic: Above the hall were nine chambers in groups of three, not following ancient form.

sentences.zh: 室間通巷，違舛處多。

translations.literal: Passageways between chambers violated the design in many places.
translations.idiomatic: Passageways between chambers violated the design in many places.

sentences.zh: 其室皆用鑿累，極成褊陋。

translations.literal: The chambers all used cut and stacked construction, extremely cramped and crude.
translations.idiomatic: The chambers all used cut and stacked construction, extremely cramped and crude.

sentences.zh: 《後魏樂志》曰：「孝昌二年立明堂，議者或言九室，或言五室，詔斷從五室。

translations.literal: The Later Wei Treatise on Music states: "In the second year of Xiaochang the Bright Hall was begun; debaters spoke of nine chambers or five chambers; an edict decided on five chambers.
translations.idiomatic: The Later Wei Treatise on Music states: "In the second year of Xiaochang the Bright Hall was begun; debaters spoke of nine chambers or five chambers; an edict decided on five chambers.

sentences.zh: 後元叉執政，復改為九室。

translations.literal: Later when Yuan Cha held power it was changed back to nine chambers.
translations.idiomatic: Later when Yuan Cha held power it was changed back to nine chambers.

sentences.zh: 遭亂不成。」

translations.literal: Rebellion prevented completion."
translations.idiomatic: Rebellion prevented completion."

sentences.zh: 宋《起居注》曰：「孝武大明五年立明堂，其牆宇規範，擬同太廟，唯十二間，以應期數。

translations.literal: The Song Daily Records states: "In the fifth year of Daming under Emperor Xiaowu the Bright Hall was begun; its walls and dimensions were modeled on the Grand Temple, with only twelve bays to correspond to the number of seasons.
translations.idiomatic: The Song Daily Records states: "In the fifth year of Daming under Emperor Xiaowu the Bright Hall was begun; its walls and dimensions were modeled on the Grand Temple, with only twelve bays to correspond to the number of seasons.

sentences.zh: 依漢《汶上圖儀》，設五帝位，太祖文皇帝對饗。

translations.literal: Following the Han diagram and rites of Mount Wen, seats for the Five Emperors were set up, with Grand Ancestor Emperor Wen facing them in shared sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Following the Han diagram and rites of Mount Wen, seats for the Five Emperors were set up, with Grand Ancestor Emperor Wen facing them in shared sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 鼎俎簠簋，一依廟禮。」

translations.literal: Tripods, stands, and vessels all followed temple ritual."
translations.idiomatic: Tripods, stands, and vessels all followed temple ritual."

sentences.zh: 梁武即位之後，移宋時太極殿以為明堂，無室，十二間。

translations.literal: After Emperor Wu of Liang ascended the throne, he moved the Taiji Hall from the Song period and made it the Bright Hall; it had no chambers and had twelve bays.
translations.idiomatic: After Emperor Wu of Liang took the throne, he moved the old Song Taiji Hall and made it the Bright Hall. It had no chambers and twelve bays.

sentences.zh: 《禮疑議》云：「祭用純，漆俎瓦樽，文於郊，質於廟，止一獻，用清酒。」

translations.literal: The Discussions of Ritual Doubts says, “In sacrifice use plain things: lacquered stands and earthen jars; be ornate in the suburb sacrifice and simple in the temple; stop at one offering and use clear wine.”
translations.idiomatic: The Discussions of Ritual Doubts says, “In sacrifice use plain things: lacquered stands and earthen jars. Be ornate in the suburb sacrifice and simple in the temple. Make only one offering, using clear wine.”

sentences.zh: 平陳之後，臣得目觀，遂量步數，記其尺丈。

translations.literal: After Chen was pacified, your subject was able to see it with his own eyes, and so measured the paces and recorded its chi and zhang.
translations.idiomatic: After Chen was pacified, I was able to see it myself, so I measured the paces and recorded its dimensions.

sentences.zh: 猶見焚燒殘柱，毀破之餘，入地一丈，儼然如舊。

translations.literal: I still saw the burned remains of pillars, the remnants after destruction, entering the ground one zhang, solemnly as of old.
translations.idiomatic: I could still see the burned remnants of pillars, surviving the destruction and sunk one zhang into the ground, standing solemnly as before.

sentences.zh: 柱下以樟木為跗，長丈餘，闊四尺許，兩兩相並，凡安數重。

translations.literal: Under the pillars, camphor wood was used as bases, more than a zhang long and about four chi wide, paired side by side, with several layers installed in all.
translations.idiomatic: Beneath the pillars were camphor-wood bases, more than a zhang long and about four chi wide, set side by side in pairs and laid in several layers.

sentences.zh: 宮城處所，乃在郭內。

translations.literal: The site of the palace city was inside the outer wall.
translations.idiomatic: The palace-city site lay within the outer wall.

sentences.zh: 雖湫隘卑陋，未合規摹，但祖宗之靈，得崇嚴祀。

translations.literal: Although it was cramped, low, and humble, and did not accord with the plan, still the spirits of the ancestors were able to receive elevated and solemn sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Although cramped, low, and humble, and not in accord with the proper plan, it still allowed the ancestral spirits to receive dignified, solemn sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 周齊二代，闕而不修，大饗之典，於焉靡托。

translations.literal: Under Zhou and Qi the work was left undone; the great feast rite had no place to rest.
translations.idiomatic: Under Zhou and Qi the work was left undone; the great feast rite had no place to rest.

sentences.zh: 自古《明堂圖》唯有二本。

translations.literal: Since antiquity there have been only two versions of the Bright Hall diagram.
translations.idiomatic: Since antiquity there have been only two versions of the Bright Hall diagram.

sentences.zh: 一是宗周，劉熙、阮諶、劉昌宗等作，三圖略同。

translations.literal: One is Zhou of the ancestral house, by Liu Xi, Ruan Chen, Liu Changzong, and others; the three diagrams are largely the same.
translations.idiomatic: One is Zhou of the ancestral house, by Liu Xi, Ruan Chen, Liu Changzong, and others; the three diagrams are largely the same.

sentences.zh: 一是後漢建武三十年作，《禮圖》有本，不詳撰人。

translations.literal: One was made in the thirtieth year of Jianwu under Later Han; the Ritual Diagram has the original, author unknown.
translations.idiomatic: One was made in the thirtieth year of Jianwu under Later Han; the Ritual Diagram has the original, author unknown.

sentences.zh: 臣遠尋《經傳》，傍求子史，研究眾說，總撰今圖。

translations.literal: Your subject searched far in classics and commentaries, sought widely in masters and histories, studied many opinions, and compiled the present diagram.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject searched far in classics and commentaries, sought widely in masters and histories, studied many opinions, and compiled the present diagram.

sentences.zh: 其樣以木為之，下為方堂，堂有五室，上為圓觀，觀有四門。

translations.literal: Its model was made of wood: below a square hall with five chambers, above a round tower with four gates.
translations.idiomatic: Its model was made of wood: below a square hall with five chambers, above a round tower with four gates.

sentences.zh: 帝可其奏。

translations.literal: The emperor approved his memorial.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved his memorial.

sentences.zh: 會遼東之役，事不果行。

translations.literal: When the Liaodong campaign came, the project was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: When the Liaodong campaign came, the project was not carried out.

sentences.zh: 以度遼之功，進位金紫光祿大夫。

translations.literal: For the merit of pacifying Liaodong he was advanced to Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Girdle.
translations.idiomatic: For the merit of pacifying Liaodong he was advanced to Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Girdle.

sentences.zh: 其年卒官，帝甚惜之，諡曰康。

translations.literal: That year he died in office; the emperor deeply regretted it and gave the posthumous title Kang.
translations.idiomatic: That year he died in office; the emperor deeply regretted it and gave the posthumous title Kang.

sentences.zh: 撰《東都圖記》二十卷、《明堂圖議》二卷、《釋疑》一卷，見行於世。

translations.literal: He compiled twenty fascicles of Records of the Eastern Capital, two fascicles of Discussions on the Bright Hall Diagram, and one fascicle of Resolving Doubts, all circulating in the world.
translations.idiomatic: He compiled twenty fascicles of Records of the Eastern Capital, two fascicles of Discussions on the Bright Hall Diagram, and one fascicle of Resolving Doubts, all circulating in the world.

sentences.zh: 長子儒童，游騎尉。

translations.literal: His eldest son Rutong was a Cavalry Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: His eldest son Rutong was a Cavalry Commandant.

sentences.zh: 少子溫，起部承務郎。

translations.literal: His younger son Wen was an Assistant Director in the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: His younger son Wen was an Assistant Director in the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 侯莫陳崇，字尚樂，代武川人也。

translations.literal: Houmo Chenchong, styled Shangle, was a man of Wuchuan in Dai.
translations.idiomatic: Houmo Chenchong, styled Shangle, was a man of Wuchuan in Dai.

sentences.zh: 其先魏之別部，居庫斛真水。

translations.literal: His ancestors were a separate branch of Wei, dwelling at Kuhuzhen River.
translations.idiomatic: His ancestors were a separate branch of Wei, dwelling at Kuhuzhen River.

sentences.zh: 祖元，以良家子鎮武川，因家焉。

translations.literal: His grandfather Yuan, as a good-family son, garrisoned Wuchuan and settled there.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Yuan, as a good-family son, garrisoned Wuchuan and settled there.

sentences.zh: 父興，殿中將軍、羽林監，後以崇著勳，追贈柱國、太保、清河郡公。

translations.literal: His father Xing was a Palace General and Captain of the Feathered Forest; later because of Chenchong's merit he was posthumously made Pillar of the State, Grand Tutor, and Duke of Qinghe Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: His father Xing was a Palace General and Captain of the Feathered Forest; later because of Chenchong's merit he was posthumously made Pillar of the State, Grand Tutor, and Duke of Qinghe Commandery.

sentences.zh: 崇少驍勇，善馳射，謹愨少言。

translations.literal: Chenchong from youth was fierce and brave, skilled in horsemanship and archery, cautious and taciturn.
translations.idiomatic: Chenchong from youth was fierce and brave, skilled in horsemanship and archery, cautious and taciturn.

sentences.zh: 年十五，隨賀拔嶽與爾硃榮征葛榮。

translations.literal: At fifteen he followed Heba Yue with Erzhu Rong against Ge Rong.
translations.idiomatic: At fifteen he followed Heba Yue with Erzhu Rong against Ge Rong.

sentences.zh: 後從岳入關，破赤水蜀。

translations.literal: Later he followed Yue into the passes and defeated the Chishui Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Later he followed Yue into the passes and defeated the Chishui Shu.

sentences.zh: 又從岳力戰，破万俟醜奴。

translations.literal: He also followed Yue in fierce fighting and defeated Moqi Chounu.
translations.idiomatic: He also followed Yue in fierce fighting and defeated Moqi Chounu.

sentences.zh: 崇與輕騎逐北，至涇州長坑及之。

translations.literal: Chenchong with light cavalry pursued north to Changkeng of Jing Province and caught up.
translations.idiomatic: Chenchong with light cavalry pursued north to Changkeng of Jing Province and caught up.

sentences.zh: 賊未成列，崇單騎入賊中，於馬上生禽醜奴，遂大破之。

translations.literal: The rebels had not yet formed ranks; Chenchong alone rode into the enemy host and captured Chounu alive from his horse, routing them completely.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels had not yet formed ranks; Chenchong alone rode into the enemy host and captured Chounu alive from his horse, routing them completely.

sentences.zh: 封臨涇縣侯。

translations.literal: He was enfeoffed Marquis of Linjing County.
translations.idiomatic: He was enfeoffed Marquis of Linjing County.

sentences.zh: 及岳為侯莫陳悅所害，崇與諸將同謀迎周文帝。

translations.literal: When Yue was killed by Houmo Chenyue, Chenchong with the generals plotted together to welcome Emperor Wen of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Yue was killed by Houmo Chenyue, Chenchong with the generals plotted together to welcome Emperor Wen of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 文帝至軍，原州刺史史歸猶為悅守。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wen reached the army, Governor Shi Gui of Yuan Province still held for Yue.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen reached the army, Governor Shi Gui of Yuan Province still held for Yue.

sentences.zh: 周文遣崇襲歸，直到城下，即據城門。

translations.literal: Emperor Wen sent Chenchong to strike Gui; reaching the foot of the city he immediately seized the gate.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen sent Chenchong to strike Gui; reaching the foot of the city he immediately seized the gate.

sentences.zh: 時李遠兄弟在城內，先知崇來，中外鼓澡，伏兵悉起，遂禽歸斬之。

translations.literal: Li Yuan and his brothers were inside the city and knew Chenchong was coming; inside and outside they beat drums and shouted; hidden troops all rose and captured and beheaded Gui.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yuan and his brothers were inside the city and knew Chenchong was coming; inside and outside they beat drums and shouted; hidden troops all rose and captured and beheaded Gui.

sentences.zh: 以崇行原州事，仍從平悅，別封廣武縣伯。

translations.literal: Chenchong was put in charge of Yuan Province affairs and followed in pacifying Yue; he was separately enfeoffed Baron of Guangwu County.
translations.idiomatic: Chenchong was put in charge of Yuan Province affairs and followed in pacifying Yue; he was separately enfeoffed Baron of Guangwu County.

sentences.zh: 累遷儀同三司，改封彭城郡公。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Master of the Same Rank as the Three Excellencies and enfeoffed Duke of Pengcheng Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to Master of the Same Rank as the Three Excellencies and enfeoffed Duke of Pengcheng Commandery.

sentences.zh: 從禽竇泰，復弘農，破沙苑，戰河又另討平稽胡，累戰皆有功，進位柱國大將軍。

translations.literal: He followed in capturing Dou Tai, recovering Hongnong, breaking Sha Plain, fighting at Heqiao, and separately suppressing the Ji Hu; in repeated battles he had merit and was advanced to Pillar of the State and Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: He followed in capturing Dou Tai, recovering Hongnong, breaking Sha Plain, fighting at Heqiao, and separately suppressing the Ji Hu; in repeated battles he had merit and was advanced to Pillar of the State and Grand General.

sentences.zh: 六官建，拜大司空。

translations.literal: When the Six Offices were established he was appointed Grand Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: When the Six Offices were established he was appointed Grand Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 周孝閔踐阼，進封梁國公，加太保。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaomin of Zhou ascended the throne, he was advanced to Duke of Liang and appointed Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaomin of Zhou ascended the throne, he was advanced to Duke of Liang and appointed Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 曆大宗伯、大司徒。

translations.literal: He served as Grand Minister of Rites and Grand Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Grand Minister of Rites and Grand Minister over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 保定三年，從武帝幸原州。

translations.literal: In the third year of Baoding he followed Emperor Wu to Yuan Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Baoding he followed Emperor Wu to Yuan Province.

sentences.zh: 時帝夜還京師，竊怪其故。

translations.literal: The emperor returned to the capital by night; secretly wondering at the reason.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor returned to the capital by night; secretly wondering at the reason.

sentences.zh: 崇謂所親人常升曰：「吾比日聞卜筮者言，晉公今年不利，車駕今忽夜還，不過是晉公死耳。」

translations.literal: Chenchong said to his close associate Chang Sheng: "I have lately heard diviners say that Duke of Jin will meet misfortune this year; the emperor's sudden return by night can only mean Duke of Jin's death."
translations.idiomatic: Chenchong said to his close associate Chang Sheng: "I have lately heard diviners say that Duke of Jin will meet misfortune this year; the emperor's sudden return by night can only mean Duke of Jin's death."

sentences.zh: 於是皆傳之。

translations.literal: Word of this spread.
translations.idiomatic: Word of this spread.

sentences.zh: 或有發其事者，帝集諸公卿於大德殿責崇，崇惶懼謝罪。

translations.literal: Someone reported the matter; the emperor assembled ministers and nobles in Dade Hall and rebuked Chenchong, who in alarm begged forgiveness.
translations.idiomatic: Someone reported the matter; the emperor assembled ministers and nobles in Dade Hall and rebuked Chenchong, who in alarm begged forgiveness.

sentences.zh: 其夜，護遣使將兵就崇宅，逼令自殺。

translations.literal: That night Hu sent men to Chenchong's residence and forced him to kill himself.
translations.idiomatic: That night Hu sent men to Chenchong's residence and forced him to kill himself.

sentences.zh: 葬禮如常儀，諡曰躁。

translations.literal: Burial followed ordinary rites; posthumous title Zao.
translations.idiomatic: Burial followed ordinary rites; posthumous title Zao.

sentences.zh: 護誅，改諡曰莊閔。

translations.literal: After Hu was executed the posthumous title was changed to Zhuangmin.
translations.idiomatic: After Hu was executed the posthumous title was changed to Zhuangmin.

sentences.zh: 子芮嗣，位柱國。

translations.literal: His son Rui succeeded, holding the rank of Pillar of the State.
translations.idiomatic: His son Rui succeeded, holding the rank of Pillar of the State.

sentences.zh: 從武帝東伐，率眾守太行道。

translations.literal: He followed Emperor Wu on the eastern campaign and led troops guarding the Taihang route.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Emperor Wu on the eastern campaign and led troops guarding the Taihang route.

sentences.zh: 并州平，授上柱國。

translations.literal: When Bing Province was pacified he was appointed Upper Pillar of the State.
translations.idiomatic: When Bing Province was pacified he was appointed Upper Pillar of the State.

sentences.zh: 仍從平鄴，拜大司馬。

translations.literal: He still followed in pacifying Ye and was appointed Grand Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: He still followed in pacifying Ye and was appointed Grand Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 隋大業初，以譴，詔流配嶺南。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Daye under Sui, through censure he was exiled to Lingnan.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Daye under Sui, through censure he was exiled to Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 芮弟穎。

translations.literal: Rui's younger brother Ying.
translations.idiomatic: Rui's younger brother was Ying.

sentences.zh: 穎字遵道，少有器量，風神警發，為時輩所推。

translations.literal: Ying, styled Zundao, from youth had capacity and measure, alert in spirit, and was admired by his contemporaries.
translations.idiomatic: Ying, courtesy name Zundao, from youth had capacity and presence, alert in spirit, and was admired by his contemporaries.

sentences.zh: 魏大統末，以父軍功，賜爵廣平侯，累遷開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: At the end of Datong under Wei, for his father's military merit he was granted the title Marquis of Guangping and was repeatedly promoted to Grand Master of the Office with the same ceremonial rank as the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Datong under Wei, for his father's military merit he was granted the title Marquis of Guangping and was repeatedly promoted to Grand Master of the Office equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 周武帝時，從滕王逌擊龍泉、文城叛胡。

translations.literal: Under Emperor Wu of Zhou he followed Prince of Teng You in attacking the rebellious Hu of Longquan and Wencheng.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Wu of Zhou he served under Prince of Teng You in the attack on the rebellious Hu of Longquan and Wencheng.

sentences.zh: 穎與柱國豆盧勣分路而進，穎懸軍五百餘里，破其三柵。

translations.literal: Ying with Pillar of the State Dou Lu Xun advanced by separate routes; Ying with his army suspended more than five hundred li away broke three stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Ying and Pillar of the State Dou Lu Xun advanced by separate routes; Ying, operating more than five hundred li from support, broke three stockades.

sentences.zh: 先是稽胡叛亂，輒略邊人為奴婢。

translations.literal: Previously when the Ji Hu rebelled they would seize border people as slaves.
translations.idiomatic: Previously when the Ji Hu rebelled they would seize border people as slaves.

sentences.zh: 至是，詔胡有厭匿良人者誅，籍沒其妻子。

translations.literal: At this time an edict decreed that any Hu who concealed good people would be executed and their wives and children confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: At this time an edict decreed that any Hu who concealed innocent people would be executed and their wives and children confiscated.

sentences.zh: 有人言為胡村所隱匿者，勳將誅之。

translations.literal: When someone said people were hidden in Hu villages, Xun was about to execute them.
translations.idiomatic: When someone said people were hidden in Hu villages, Xun was about to execute them.

sentences.zh: 穎曰：「將在外，君命有所不行。

translations.literal: Ying said: "A general in the field need not obey every order of his ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Ying said, "A general in the field need not obey every order of his ruler.

sentences.zh: 諸胡固非悉反，但相迫脅為亂。

translations.literal: The various Hu are certainly not all in rebellion; they were forced and coerced into disorder.
translations.idiomatic: The various Hu are certainly not all in rebellion; they were forced and coerced into disorder.

sentences.zh: 今慰撫，自可不戰而定；

translations.literal: If we now pacify them, they can be settled without fighting;
translations.idiomatic: If we now pacify them, they can be settled without fighting;

sentences.zh: 如即誅之，轉相驚恐，為難不細。

translations.literal: if we execute them at once, fear will spread and the trouble will be no small matter.
translations.idiomatic: if we execute them at once, fear will spread and the trouble will be no small matter.

sentences.zh: 未若召其渠帥，以隱匿才付之，令自歸首，則群胡可安。」

translations.literal: It would be better to summon their chieftains, entrust the hidden people to them, and have them surrender themselves; then the Hu can be pacified."
translations.idiomatic: It would be better to summon their chieftains, entrust the hidden people to them, and have them surrender themselves; then the Hu can be pacified."

sentences.zh: 勣從之，諸胡爭降附，北土以安。

translations.literal: Xun agreed; the Hu competed to submit, and the north was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Xun agreed; the Hu competed to submit, and the north was pacified.

sentences.zh: 遷司武，加振威中大夫。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Director of Martial Affairs and promoted to Grand Master of Inspiring Might.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Director of Martial Affairs and promoted to Grand Master of Inspiring Might.

sentences.zh: 隋文帝受禪，加上開府，進爵升平郡公。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wen of Sui accepted the abdication, Ying was promoted to Upper Grand Master of the Office and advanced to Duke of Shengping Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen of Sui accepted the throne, Ying was promoted to Upper Grand Master of the Office and enfeoffed Duke of Shengping Commandery.

sentences.zh: 平陳之役，以行軍總管從秦王俊出魯山道，與行軍總管段文振度江，安集歸附。

translations.literal: In the campaign to pacify Chen, as Campaign Commander he followed Prince of Qin Jun by the Lushan route; with Campaign Commander Duan Wenzhen he crossed the Yangtze and settled those who submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the campaign to pacify Chen, as campaign commander he followed Prince of Qin Jun by the Lushan route; with campaign commander Duan Wenzhen he crossed the Yangtze and settled those who submitted.

sentences.zh: 再遷瀛州刺史，甚有惠政。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to Governor of Ying Province and governed with great benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: He was again appointed Governor of Ying Province and governed with great benevolence.

sentences.zh: 後坐與秦王俊交通，免官。

translations.literal: Later he was dismissed for associating with Prince of Qin Jun.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was dismissed for associating with Prince of Qin Jun.

sentences.zh: 百姓送者莫不流涕，因相與立碑，頌穎清德。

translations.literal: Those who escorted him all wept; they therefore erected a stele together praising Ying's pure virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Those who escorted him all wept; they therefore erected a stele together praising Ying's pure virtue.

sentences.zh: 後拜邢州刺史。

translations.literal: Later he was appointed Governor of Xing Province.
translations.idiomatic: He was later appointed Governor of Xing Province.

sentences.zh: 仁壽中，吏部尚書牛弘持節巡撫山東，以穎為第一，上優詔褒揚。

translations.literal: During Renshou, Minister of Personnel Niu Hong toured Shandong with imperial credentials and ranked Ying first; the emperor issued a commendatory edict.
translations.idiomatic: During Renshou, Minister of Personnel Niu Hong toured Shandong with imperial credentials and ranked Ying first; the emperor issued a commendatory edict.

sentences.zh: 時朝廷以嶺南刺史縣令多貪鄙，蠻夷怨叛，妙簡清吏。

translations.literal: At the time governors and magistrates of Lingnan were mostly greedy and base, the tribes resented and rebelled, and worthy clean officials were carefully selected.
translations.idiomatic: At the time governors and magistrates of Lingnan were mostly greedy and base, the tribes resented and rebelled, and worthy clean officials were carefully selected.

sentences.zh: 於是征穎入朝。

translations.literal: Ying was therefore summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: Ying was therefore summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 上與言及平生，以為歡笑，即日進位大將軍，拜桂州總管、十七州諸軍事。

translations.literal: The emperor spoke with him of his whole life and found it amusing; that same day he was advanced to Grand General and appointed Commander-in-Chief of Gui Province over seventeen provinces.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor spoke with him of his whole life and found it amusing; that same day he was advanced to Grand General and appointed Commander-in-Chief of Gui Province over seventeen provinces.

sentences.zh: 及至官，大崇恩信，人夷悅服。

translations.literal: When he reached office he greatly extended grace and trust; people and tribes were pleased and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached office he greatly extended grace and trust; people and tribes were pleased and submitted.

sentences.zh: 煬帝即位，穎兄梁國公芮坐事徙邊，圾廷恐穎不自安，征還京師。

translations.literal: When Emperor Yang ascended the throne, Ying's elder brother Duke of Liang Rui was banished for a crime; the court feared Ying would be unsettled and summoned him back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yang ascended the throne, Ying's elder brother Duke of Liang Rui was banished for a crime; the court feared Ying would be unsettled and summoned him back to the capital.

sentences.zh: 後拜恆山太。

translations.literal: Later he was appointed Governor of Hengshan.
translations.idiomatic: He was later appointed Governor of Hengshan.

sentences.zh: 其年，嶺南、閩越多不附，帝以穎前在桂州有惠政，為南方所信伏，拜南海太守。

translations.literal: That year Lingnan and Min-Yue were mostly unsubmissive; the emperor, because Ying had benevolent government at Gui Province and was trusted in the south, appointed him Governor of Nanhai.
translations.idiomatic: That year Lingnan and Min-Yue were mostly unsubmissive; the emperor, because Ying had benevolent government at Gui Province and was trusted in the south, appointed him Governor of Nanhai.

sentences.zh: 卒官，諡曰定。

translations.literal: He died in office; posthumous title Ding.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office; posthumous title Ding.

sentences.zh: 子虔會最知名。

translations.literal: His son Qianhui was most renowned.
translations.idiomatic: His son Qianhui was most renowned.

sentences.zh: 崇兄順，少豪俠有志度。

translations.literal: Chenchong's elder brother Shun from youth was bold and chivalrous with ambition and measure.
translations.idiomatic: Chenchong's elder brother Shun from youth was bold and chivalrous with ambition and measure.

sentences.zh: 初事爾硃榮為統軍。

translations.literal: At first he served Erzhu Rong as commander.
translations.idiomatic: At first he served Erzhu Rong as commander.

sentences.zh: 普泰元年，封木縣子。

translations.literal: In the first year of Putai he was enfeoffed Baron of Mu County.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Putai he was enfeoffed Baron of Mu County.

sentences.zh: 後從魏孝武入關。

translations.literal: Later he followed Emperor Xiaowu of Wei into the passes.
translations.idiomatic: Later he followed Emperor Xiaowu of Wei into the passes.

sentences.zh: 順與周文帝同里幹，素相友善，且崇先在關中，周文見之甚歡，進爵彭城郡公。

translations.literal: Shun and Emperor Wen of Zhou were from the same district and had long been friendly; moreover Chenchong was already in Guanzhong, and when Emperor Wen saw Shun he was very pleased and advanced him to Duke of Pengcheng Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Shun and Emperor Wen of Zhou were from the same district and had long been friendly; moreover Chenchong was already in Guanzhong, and when Emperor Wen saw Shun he was very pleased and enfeoffed him Duke of Pengcheng Commandery.

sentences.zh: 及梁ＧＣ定圍逼河州，以順為大都督，與趙貴討破之，即行河州事。

translations.literal: When Liang Miding besieged He Province, Shun was made Grand Commandant and with Zhao Gui defeated and drove him off, then administered He Province affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When Liang Miding besieged He Province, Shun was made Grand Commandant and with Zhao Gui defeated and drove him off, then administered He Province affairs.

sentences.zh: 大統四年，魏文帝東討，順與太尉王盟、僕射周惠達等留鎮長安。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Datong, when Emperor Wen of Wei marched east, Shun with Grand Commandant Wang Meng and Vice Director Zhou Huida remained to guard Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Datong, when Emperor Wen of Wei marched east, Shun with Grand Commandant Wang Meng and Vice Director Zhou Huida remained to guard Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 時趙青雀反，盟及惠達奉魏太子出次渭北。

translations.literal: When Zhao Qingque rebelled, Meng and Huida escorted the Wei heir apparent to camp north of the Wei River.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhao Qingque rebelled, Meng and Huida escorted the Wei heir apparent to camp north of the Wei River.

sentences.zh: 順于渭橋與賊戰，頻破之。

translations.literal: Shun fought the rebels at Weiqiao and repeatedly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Shun fought the rebels at Weiqiao and repeatedly defeated them.

sentences.zh: 魏文帝還，執順手曰：「渭橋之戰，卿有殊力。」

translations.literal: When Emperor Wen of Wei returned, he took Shun's hand and said: "At the battle of Weiqiao you showed exceptional strength."
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen of Wei returned, he took Shun's hand and said, "At the battle of Weiqiao you showed exceptional strength."

sentences.zh: 便解所服金鏤玉梁帶賜之。

translations.literal: He then removed the gold-inlaid jade-buckled belt he was wearing and gave it to him.
translations.idiomatic: He then removed the gold-inlaid jade-buckled belt he was wearing and gave it to him.

sentences.zh: 南岐州氐苻安壽。

translations.literal: Fu Anshou of the Di of Southern Qi Province.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Anshou of the Di of Southern Qi Province.

sentences.zh: 遂率部落一千家款附。

translations.literal: He then led more than a thousand households of his tribe to submit.
translations.idiomatic: He then led more than a thousand households of his tribe to submit.

sentences.zh: 時順弟崇又封彭城郡公，遂改封順河間郡公。

translations.literal: At the time Shun's younger brother Chenchong was also enfeoffed Duke of Pengcheng Commandery, so Shun's title was changed to Duke of Hejian Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Shun's younger brother Chenchong was also enfeoffed Duke of Pengcheng Commandery, so Shun's title was changed to Duke of Hejian Commandery.

sentences.zh: 六年，加驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，行西夏州事，改封平原郡公。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was promoted to General of Agile Cavalry, Grand Master of the Office with the same ceremonial rank as the Three Excellencies, and administered Western Xia Province affairs; his title was changed to Duke of Pingyuan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was promoted to General of Agile Cavalry, Grand Master of the Office equal to the Three Excellencies, and administered Western Xia Province affairs; his title was changed to Duke of Pingyuan Commandery.

sentences.zh: 周孝閔帝踐阼，拜少師，進位柱國。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaomin of Zhou ascended the throne, he was appointed Junior Tutor and advanced to Pillar of the State.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaomin of Zhou ascended the throne, he was appointed Junior Tutor and promoted to Pillar of the State.

sentences.zh: 其年薨。

translations.literal: That year he died.
translations.idiomatic: That year he died.

sentences.zh: 崇弟瓊，歷位荊州總管、上柱國，封修武郡公。

translations.literal: Chenchong's younger brother Qiong held the posts of Commander-in-Chief of Jing Province and Upper Pillar of the State and was enfeoffed Duke of Xiuwu Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Chenchong's younger brother Qiong held the posts of Commander-in-Chief of Jing Province and Upper Pillar of the State and was enfeoffed Duke of Xiuwu Commandery.

sentences.zh: 瓊弟凱，以軍功賜爵下蔡縣男。

translations.literal: Qiong's younger brother Kai was granted the title Baron of Xiacai County for military merit.
translations.idiomatic: Qiong's younger brother Kai was granted the title Baron of Xiacai County for military merit.

sentences.zh: 崇以平原州功，賜爵靈武縣侯，詔聽轉授凱。

translations.literal: Chenchong, for merit at Pingyuan Province, was granted the title Marquis of Lingwu County; an edict allowed transfer to Kai.
translations.idiomatic: Chenchong, for merit at Pingyuan Province, was granted the title Marquis of Lingwu County; an edict allowed transfer to Kai.

sentences.zh: 孝閔踐阼，進位開府儀同三司，進爵為公。

translations.literal: When Xiaomin ascended the throne, Kai was advanced to Grand Master of the Office with the same ceremonial rank as the Three Excellencies and promoted to duke.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiaomin ascended the throne, Kai was advanced to Grand Master of the Office equal to the Three Excellencies and promoted to duke.

sentences.zh: 天和中，為司會中大夫。

translations.literal: During Tianhe he was Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: During Tianhe he was Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 建德二年，為聘齊使主。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiande he was chief envoy on a marriage mission to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jiande he was chief envoy on a marriage mission to Qi.

sentences.zh: 王雄，字胡布頭，太原人也。

translations.literal: Wang Xiong, styled Hubutou, was a man of Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xiong, courtesy name Hubutou, was from Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 父崘，以雄著勳，追贈柱國大將軍、少傅、安康郡公。

translations.literal: His father Song, because of Xiong's merit, was posthumously made Pillar of the State, Grand General, Junior Tutor, and Duke of Ankang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: His father Song, because of Xiong's merit, was posthumously enfeoffed Pillar of the State, Grand General, Junior Tutor, and Duke of Ankang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 雄儀貌魁梧，少有謀略。

translations.literal: Xiong was imposing in appearance and from youth had strategic insight.
translations.idiomatic: Xiong was imposing in appearance and from youth had strategic insight.

sentences.zh: 魏末，從賀拔岳入關，除金紫光祿大夫。

translations.literal: At the end of Wei he followed Heba Yue into the passes and was appointed Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Girdle.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Wei he followed Heba Yue into the passes and was appointed Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Girdle.

sentences.zh: 孝武西遷，封臨貞縣伯。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaowu moved west, he was enfeoffed Baron of Linzhen County.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaowu moved west, he was enfeoffed Baron of Linzhen County.

sentences.zh: 大統中，進爵武威郡公，累遷大將軍，行同州事。

translations.literal: During Datong he was advanced to Duke of Wuwei Commandery and repeatedly promoted to Grand General, administering Tong Province affairs.
translations.idiomatic: During Datong he was enfeoffed Duke of Wuwei Commandery and repeatedly promoted to Grand General, administering Tong Province affairs.

sentences.zh: 恭帝元年，賜姓可頻氏。

translations.literal: In the first year of Emperor Gong he was granted the surname Kepin.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Emperor Gong he was granted the surname Kepin.

sentences.zh: 周孝閔帝踐阼，授少傅，進位柱國大將軍。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaomin of Zhou ascended the throne, he was appointed Junior Tutor and advanced to Pillar of the State and Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaomin of Zhou ascended the throne, he was appointed Junior Tutor and promoted to Pillar of the State and Grand General.

sentences.zh: 武成初，進封庸國公，邑萬戶。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Wucheng he was advanced to Duke of Yong with a fief of ten thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Wucheng era he was enfeoffed Duke of Yong with a fief of ten thousand households.

sentences.zh: 出為涇州總管。

translations.literal: He went out as Commander-in-Chief of Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Jing Province.

sentences.zh: 保定四年，從晉公護東征，至芒山，與齊將斛律明月戰。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Baoding, he followed Hu, Duke of Jin, on the eastern campaign; when they reached Mangshan, he fought the Qi general Huliu Mingyue.
translations.idiomatic: In 564, he followed Yuwen Hu, Duke of Jin, on the eastern campaign. At Mangshan he fought the Qi general Huliu Mingyue.

sentences.zh: 退走，左右皆散，矢又盡，唯餘一奴一矢在焉。

translations.literal: He retreated and fled; his attendants all scattered, and his arrows were also exhausted, with only one servant and one arrow left.
translations.idiomatic: He retreated, his attendants scattered, and his arrows ran out, leaving only one servant and one arrow.

sentences.zh: 雄案稍不及明月者丈餘，曰：「惜爾，不得殺，但生將爾見天子。」

translations.literal: Xiong pressed his crossbow, but it fell more than a zhang short of Mingyue, and he said, “It is a pity I cannot kill you, but I will take you alive to see the Son of Heaven.”
translations.idiomatic: Xiong aimed his crossbow, but the shot fell more than a zhang short of Mingyue. He said, “Too bad I cannot kill you; instead I will take you alive to see the Son of Heaven.”

sentences.zh: 明月反射雄中額，抱馬走至營，薨。

translations.literal: Mingyue shot back and hit Xiong in the forehead; Xiong clung to his horse and fled back to camp, where he died.
translations.idiomatic: Mingyue shot back and struck Xiong in the forehead. Xiong clung to his horse and made it back to camp, where he died.

sentences.zh: 贈使持節、太保、同華等二十州諸軍事、同州刺史，諡曰忠。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted Acting with the Staff, Grand Protector, military affairs of twenty provinces including Tong and Hua, and Inspector of Tongzhou; his posthumous name was Zhong.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously honored as Acting with the Staff, Grand Protector, commander of military affairs for twenty provinces including Tong and Hua, and Inspector of Tongzhou, with the posthumous name Zhong.

sentences.zh: 子謙。

translations.literal: His son was Qian.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Qian.

sentences.zh: 謙字敕萬，性恭謹，無他才能，以父功封安樂縣伯。

translations.literal: Qian, styled Chimo, was respectful and cautious by nature, without other talent; for his father's merit he was enfeoffed Baron of Anle County.
translations.idiomatic: Qian, courtesy name Chimo, was respectful and cautious by nature, without other talent; for his father's merit he was enfeoffed Baron of Anle County.

sentences.zh: 保定二年，父雄封庸國公，以武威郡公回封謙，安樂伯回封第三弟震。

translations.literal: In the second year of Baoding, when his father Xiong was enfeoffed Duke of Yong, the Duke of Wuwei title was transferred to Qian, and the Baron of Anle title was transferred to the third younger brother Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Baoding, when his father Xiong was enfeoffed Duke of Yong, the Duke of Wuwei title was transferred to Qian, and the Baron of Anle title was transferred to the third younger brother Zhen.

sentences.zh: 雄死，朝議以謙父殞行陣，特加殊寵，授柱國大將軍，襲爵庸國公。

translations.literal: When Xiong died, court discussion because Qian's father had fallen on campaign granted special favor and appointed Qian Pillar of the State and Grand General, inheriting the title Duke of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiong died, court discussion because Qian's father had fallen on campaign granted special favor and appointed Qian Pillar of the State and Grand General, inheriting the title Duke of Yong.

sentences.zh: 建德五年，武帝東征，謙力戰，進位上柱國。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Jiande, when Emperor Wu marched east, Qian fought fiercely and was advanced to Upper Pillar of the State.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Jiande, when Emperor Wu marched east, Qian fought fiercely and was promoted to Upper Pillar of the State.

sentences.zh: 六年，授益州總管十八州諸軍事。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Yi Province over eighteen provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Yi Province over eighteen provinces.

sentences.zh: 及宣帝崩，隋文帝輔政，以梁睿為益州總管。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xuan died and Emperor Wen of Sui served as regent, Liang Rui was made Commander-in-Chief of Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuan died and Emperor Wen of Sui served as regent, Liang Rui was made Commander-in-Chief of Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 時謙使司錄賀若昂奉表詣闕。

translations.literal: At the time Qian sent Registrar He Ruo'ang to court with a memorial.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Qian sent Registrar He Ruo'ang to court with a memorial.

sentences.zh: 昂還，具陳京師事。

translations.literal: When Ang returned he fully reported affairs of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: When Ang returned he fully reported affairs of the capital.

sentences.zh: 謙以父子受國恩，將圖匡復，遂舉兵，署置官司。

translations.literal: Qian, because father and son had received the state's grace, planned restoration and thereupon raised troops and established offices.
translations.idiomatic: Qian, because father and son had received the state's grace, planned restoration and thereupon raised troops and established offices.

sentences.zh: 總管長史乙弗虔、益州刺史達奚惎勸謙憑險觀變。

translations.literal: Chief Clerk Yifu Qian and Governor of Yi Province Daxi Ji urged Qian to rely on difficult terrain and watch for changes.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Clerk Yifu Qian and Governor of Yi Province Daxi Ji urged Qian to rely on difficult terrain and watch for changes.

sentences.zh: 隆州刺史高阿那肱為謙畫三策曰：「公親率精銳，直指散關，蜀人知公有勤王之節，必當各思效命，此上策也；

translations.literal: Governor of Long Province Gao Anagou drew three plans for Qian: "My lord personally leads elite troops straight at Sanguan; the people of Shu, knowing you have the principle of rescuing the ruler, will surely wish to serve—this is the upper plan;
translations.idiomatic: Governor of Long Province Gao Anagou drew three plans for Qian: "My lord personally leads elite troops straight at Sanguan; the people of Shu, knowing you have the principle of rescuing the ruler, will surely wish to serve—this is the upper plan;

sentences.zh: 出兵梁、漢，以顧望天下，此中策也；

translations.literal: send troops through Liang and Han to watch the realm—this is the middle plan;
translations.idiomatic: send troops through Liang and Han to watch the realm—this is the middle plan;

sentences.zh: 坐守劍南，發兵自衛，此下策也。」

translations.literal: sit and guard Jiannan and raise troops for self-defense—this is the lower plan."
translations.idiomatic: sit and guard Jiannan and raise troops for self-defense—this is the lower plan."

sentences.zh: 謙參用其中下之策。

translations.literal: Qian adopted the middle and lower plans.
translations.idiomatic: Qian adopted the middle and lower plans.

sentences.zh: 梁睿未至大劍，謙先遣兵鎮始州。

translations.literal: Before Liang Rui reached Great Sword Pass, Qian first sent troops to garrison Shizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Before Liang Rui reached Great Sword Pass, Qian first sent troops to garrison Shizhou.

sentences.zh: 隋文帝即以睿為行軍元帥，便發利、鳳、文、秦、成諸州兵討之。

translations.literal: Emperor Wen of Sui immediately made Rui Campaign Marshal and sent troops from Li, Feng, Wen, Qin, and Cheng Provinces against him.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen of Sui immediately made Rui campaign marshal and sent troops from Li, Feng, Wen, Qin, and Cheng Provinces against him.

sentences.zh: 謙所署柱國達奚惎、高阿那肱、大將軍乙弗虔、楊安、任峻、侯翕、景孱等眾號十萬，盡銳攻利州，總管、楚國公豆盧勣拒戰將四旬。

translations.literal: Qian's appointed Pillar of the State Daxi Ji, Gao Anagou, Grand Generals Yifu Qian, Yang An, Ren Jun, Hou Xi, Jing Can, and others numbered one hundred thousand in name; with full strength they attacked Li Province; Commander-in-Chief Duke of Chu Dou Lu Xun resisted for nearly forty days.
translations.idiomatic: Qian's appointed Pillar of the State Daxi Ji, Gao Anagou, Grand Generals Yifu Qian, Yang An, Ren Jun, Hou Xi, Jing Can, and others numbered one hundred thousand in name; with full strength they attacked Li Province; Commander-in-Chief Duke of Chu Dou Lu Xun resisted for nearly forty days.

sentences.zh: 惎等諸軍聞睿將至，眾遂潰。

translations.literal: When Ji and the other armies heard Rui was coming, the host collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: When Ji and the other armies heard Rui was coming, the host collapsed.

sentences.zh: 謙所署大將軍苻子英攻巴州，又為刺史呂珍所破。

translations.literal: Qian's appointed Grand General Fu Ziying attacked Ba Province and was again defeated by Governor Lu Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: Qian's appointed Grand General Fu Ziying attacked Ba Province and was again defeated by Governor Lu Zhen.

sentences.zh: 睿乘其弊，縱兵深入。

translations.literal: Rui exploited their weakness and sent troops deep in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: Rui exploited their weakness and sent troops deep in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 棋、虔密遣使詣睿，請為內應以贖罪。

translations.literal: Ji and Qian secretly sent envoys to Rui asking to serve as inside collaborators to atone.
translations.idiomatic: Ji and Qian secretly sent envoys to Rui asking to serve as inside collaborators to atone.

sentences.zh: 謙不知惎、虔之反己也，並令守成都。

translations.literal: Qian did not know Ji and Qian had turned against him and ordered them both to guard Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: Qian did not know Ji and Qian had turned against him and ordered them both to guard Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 謙先無籌略，且所任用多非其才，及聞睿兵奄至，惶懼計無所出，乃自率眾逆戰，又以惎、虔之子為左右軍。

translations.literal: Qian had no strategy beforehand and mostly appointed men without talent; when he heard Rui's army had suddenly arrived he was alarmed with no plan, led his host to meet the attack himself, and placed Ji and Qian's sons in the left and right armies.
translations.idiomatic: Qian had no strategy beforehand and mostly appointed men without talent; when he heard Rui's army had suddenly arrived he was alarmed with no plan, led his host to meet the attack himself, and placed Ji and Qian's sons in the left and right armies.

sentences.zh: 行數十里，左右軍皆叛，謙奔新都，縣令王寶執而斬之，傅首京師。

translations.literal: After marching several tens of li, both left and right armies rebelled; Qian fled to Xindu, and Magistrate Wang Bao seized and beheaded him and sent his head to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: After marching several tens of li, both left and right armies rebelled; Qian fled to Xindu, and Magistrate Wang Bao seized and beheaded him and sent his head to the capital.

sentences.zh: 惎、虔以成都降。

translations.literal: Ji and Qian surrendered Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: Ji and Qian surrendered Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 隋文帝以惎、虔首謀，令殺之於蜀市。

translations.literal: Emperor Wen of Sui, because Ji and Qian were the chief plotters, ordered them executed in the Shu market.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen of Sui, because Ji and Qian were the chief plotters, ordered them executed in the Shu market.

sentences.zh: 餘眾並散。

translations.literal: The remaining host all scattered.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining host all scattered.

sentences.zh: 阿那肱尋亦被誅。

translations.literal: Anagou was also executed soon after.
translations.idiomatic: Anagou was also executed soon after.

sentences.zh: 論曰：李弼懷佐時之略，逢興運之期，締構艱難，綢繆顧遇，方面宣其庸績，帷幄盡其謀猷，非唯攀附成名，抑亦材謀自取。

translations.literal: The commentators say: Li Bi possessed the strategy to assist his age and met the season of rising fortune; he built through hardship and received careful favor; in the regions he displayed his achievements, in the command tent he exhausted his plans—not only did he win fame through attachment, he also earned it through talent and strategy.
translations.idiomatic: The commentators say: Li Bi possessed the strategy to assist his age and met the season of rising fortune; he built through hardship and received careful favor; in the regions he displayed his achievements, in the command tent he exhausted his plans—not only did he win fame through attachment, he also earned it through talent and strategy.

sentences.zh: 密遭風雲之會，奮其鱗翼，思封函谷，將割鴻溝，期月之間，眾數十萬。

translations.literal: Mi met the season of storm and cloud and spread his scales and wings, intending to seal Hangu Pass and cut the Hong Canal; within months his host numbered hundreds of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Mi met the season of storm and cloud and spread his scales and wings, intending to seal Hangu Pass and cut the Hong Canal; within months his host numbered hundreds of thousands.

sentences.zh: 威行萬里，聲動四方。

translations.literal: His authority reached ten thousand li, his renown shook the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: His authority reached ten thousand li, his renown shook the four quarters.

sentences.zh: 雖事屈興王，運乖天眷，而雄名克振，何其壯歟！

translations.literal: Although affairs went against the rising king and fortune opposed Heaven's favor, his fierce name could still resound—how magnificent!
translations.idiomatic: Although affairs went against the rising king and fortune opposed Heaven's favor, his fierce name could still resound—how magnificent!

sentences.zh: 然志性輕狡，終致顛覆，固其宜也。

translations.literal: Yet his disposition was frivolous and cunning, and in the end he was overthrown—as was fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Yet his disposition was frivolish and cunning, and in the end he was overthrown—as was fitting.

sentences.zh: 宇文貴負將帥之材，蘊剛銳之氣，遭逢喪亂，險阻備嘗，自致高位，亦云美矣。

translations.literal: Yuwen Gui possessed the material of a general and the spirit of firm sharpness; meeting disorder and passing through dangers, he rose to high position himself—this too was admirable.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Gui possessed the material of a general and the spirit of firm sharpness; meeting disorder and passing through dangers, he rose to high position himself—this too was admirable.

sentences.zh: 忻武藝之風，名高一代。

translations.literal: Xin's martial style made his name tower over a generation.
translations.idiomatic: Xin's martial style made his name tower over a generation.

sentences.zh: 及晚節遇禍，雖鳥盡弓藏，然亦器盈斯概，夷戮非為不幸。

translations.literal: When in his later years he met disaster, although the bow is stored when the birds are gone, his vessel was full to bursting, and execution was not undeserved.
translations.idiomatic: When in his later years he met disaster, although the bow is stored when the birds are gone, his vessel was full to bursting, and execution was not undeserved.

sentences.zh: 愷學藝兼該，思理通贍，規矩之妙，參從班、爾，當時缺席，咸取則焉。

translations.literal: Kai's learning and arts were comprehensive, his thought clear and ample; in the subtlety of rules and measures he followed Ban and Er, and when the age lacked models all took him as standard.
translations.idiomatic: Kai's learning and arts were comprehensive, his thought clear and ample; in the subtlety of rules and measures he followed Ban and Er, and when the age lacked models all took him as standard.

sentences.zh: 其起仁壽宮，營建洛邑，要求時幸，窮侈極麗，使文皇失德，煬帝亡身，危亂之原，抑亦由此。

translations.literal: In building Renshou Palace and constructing Luoyang, seeking the emperor's favor, extravagance reached its extreme, causing Emperor Wen to lose virtue and Emperor Yang to lose his life—the root of peril and disorder arose from this as well.
translations.idiomatic: In building Renshou Palace and constructing Luoyang, seeking the emperor's favor, extravagance reached its extreme, causing Emperor Wen to lose virtue and Emperor Yang to lose his life—the root of peril and disorder arose from this as well.

sentences.zh: 至於考覽書傳，定《明堂圖》，雖意過其通，有足觀者。

translations.literal: As for examining books and records and fixing the Bright Hall diagram, although his intent exceeded his mastery, it is still worth viewing.
translations.idiomatic: As for examining books and records and fixing the Bright Hall diagram, although his intent exceeded his mastery, it is still worth viewing.

sentences.zh: 侯莫陳崇以勇悍之氣，逢戰爭之秋，輕騎啟高平之扉，疋馬和長坑之俊。

translations.literal: Houmo Chenchong with fierce and bold spirit met the season of war; with light cavalry he opened the gate of Gaoping, and with a single horse he matched the excellence of Changkeng.
translations.idiomatic: Houmo Chenchong with fierce and bold spirit met the season of war; with light cavalry he opened the gate of Gaoping, and with a single horse he matched the excellence of Changkeng.

sentences.zh: 以宏材遠略，附鳳攀龍，茂績元勳，位居上袞，而識慚明哲，遂以凶終，惜哉！

translations.literal: With great talent and far-reaching strategy he attached to the phoenix and climbed the dragon; with splendid achievements and primary merit he stood at the highest rank of nobility—yet lacking the discernment of the wise, he met a violent end in the end. Pity!
translations.idiomatic: With great talent and far-reaching strategy he attached to the phoenix and climbed the dragon; with splendid achievements and primary merit he stood at the highest rank of nobility—yet lacking the discernment of the wise, he met a violent end in the end. Pity!

sentences.zh: 王雄身參佐命，謙寵列山河，及投袂勤王，志匡社稷，雖忠君之效未宣，與夫懷祿圖存者異也。

translations.literal: Wang Xiong personally shared in founding merit; Qian enjoyed noble rank and fief; when he raised his sleeve to serve the ruler in loyalty and wished to restore the state, although the effect of loyal service was not proclaimed, he differed from those who cherish salary and plot survival.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xiong personally shared in founding merit; Qian enjoyed noble rank and fief; when he raised his sleeve to serve the ruler in loyalty and wished to restore the state, although the effect of loyal service was not proclaimed, he differed from those who cherish salary and plot survival.

sentences.zh: 初，魏孝莊帝以爾硃榮有翊戴之功，拜榮柱國大將軍，位在丞相上。

translations.literal: At first Emperor Xiaozhuang of Wei, because Erzhu Rong had merit in supporting and establishing him, appointed Rong Pillar of the State and Grand General, ranking above the Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: At first Emperor Xiaozhuang of Wei, because Erzhu Rong had merit in supporting and establishing him, appointed Rong Pillar of the State and Grand General, ranking above the chancellor.

sentences.zh: 榮敗後，此官遂廢。

translations.literal: After Rong's defeat this office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: After Rong's defeat this office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 大統三年，魏文帝復以周文帝建中興之業，始命為之。

translations.literal: In the third year of Datong, Emperor Wen of Wei again because Emperor Wen of Zhou had established the enterprise of revival first ordered it restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Datong, Emperor Wen of Wei again because Emperor Wen of Zhou had established the enterprise of revival first ordered it restored.

sentences.zh: 其後功參佐命，望實俱重者亦居此職。

translations.literal: Thereafter those whose merit shared in founding and whose reputation and substance were both weighty also held this post.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter those whose merit shared in founding and whose reputation and substance were both weighty also held this post.

sentences.zh: 自大統十六年已前，任者凡有八人。

translations.literal: Before the sixteenth year of Datong there were eight who held it.
translations.idiomatic: Before the sixteenth year of Datong there were eight who held it.

sentences.zh: 周文帝位總百揆，都督中外軍事。

translations.literal: Emperor Wen of Zhou held overall direction of all affairs and was Commander-in-Chief over central and outer military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen of Zhou held overall direction of all affairs and was commander-in-chief over central and outer military affairs.

sentences.zh: 魏廣陵王欣，元氏懿戚，從容禁闥而已。

translations.literal: Prince of Guangling Xin of the Yuan clan, an imperial relative, merely attended at the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Guangling Xin of the Yuan clan, an imperial relative, merely attended at the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 此外六人，各督二大將軍，分掌禁旅，當爪牙禦侮之寄。

translations.literal: The other six each commanded two grand generals, dividing command of the palace guard—the charge of claws and fangs to repel insult.
translations.idiomatic: The other six each commanded two grand generals, dividing command of the palace guard—the charge of claws and fangs to repel insult.

sentences.zh: 當時榮盛，莫與為比。

translations.literal: The glory of the time had no equal.
translations.idiomatic: The glory of the time had no equal.

sentences.zh: 故今之稱門閥者，咸推八柱國家。

translations.literal: Therefore those who today speak of great clans all honor the eight Pillar-of-the-State families.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore those who today speak of great clans all honor the eight Pillar-of-the-State families.

sentences.zh: 今並十二大將軍錄之于左：

translations.literal: Now the twelve Grand Generals are recorded below:
translations.idiomatic: Now the twelve Grand Generals are recorded below:

sentences.zh: 使持節、太尉、柱國大將軍、大都督、尚書左僕射、隴右行台、少師、隴西郡開國公虎。

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand Commandant, Pillar of the State and Grand General, Grand Commandant, Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs on the Left, Commissioner of the Longyou Circuit, Junior Tutor, Duke of Longxi Commandery Yuwen Tai.
translations.idiomatic: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand Commandant, Pillar of the State and Grand General, Grand Commandant, Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs on the Left, Commissioner of the Longyou Circuit, Junior Tutor, Duke of Longxi Commandery Yuwen Tai.

sentences.zh: 使持節、太傅、柱國大將軍、大宗師、大司徒、廣陵王元欣。

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand Tutor, Pillar of the State and Grand General, Grand Master of the Ancestral Temple, Grand Minister over the Masses, Prince of Guangling Yuan Xin.
translations.idiomatic: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand Tutor, Pillar of the State and Grand General, Grand Master of the Ancestral Temple, Grand Minister over the Masses, Prince of Guangling Yuan Xin.

sentences.zh: 使持節、柱國大將軍、大都督、大宗伯、趙郡開國公李弼。

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Pillar of the State and Grand General, Grand Commandant, Grand Minister of Rites, Duke of Zhao Commandery Li Bi.
translations.idiomatic: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Pillar of the State and Grand General, Grand Commandant, Grand Minister of Rites, Duke of Zhao Commandery Li Bi.

sentences.zh: 使持節、柱國大將軍、大都督、大司馬、河內郡開國公獨孤信。

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Pillar of the State and Grand General, Grand Commandant, Grand Minister of War, Duke of Henei Commandery Dugu Xin.
translations.idiomatic: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Pillar of the State and Grand General, Grand Commandant, Grand Minister of War, Duke of Henei Commandery Dugu Xin.

sentences.zh: 使持節、柱國大將軍、大都督、大司寇、南陽郡開國公趙貴。

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Pillar of the State and Grand General, Grand Commandant, Grand Minister of Justice, Duke of Nanyang Commandery Zhao Gui.
translations.idiomatic: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Pillar of the State and Grand General, Grand Commandant, Grand Minister of Justice, Duke of Nanyang Commandery Zhao Gui.

sentences.zh: 使持節、柱國大將軍、大都督、大司空、常山郡開國公於謹。

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Pillar of the State and Grand General, Grand Commandant, Grand Minister of Works, Duke of Changshan Commandery Yu Jin.
translations.idiomatic: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Pillar of the State and Grand General, Grand Commandant, Grand Minister of Works, Duke of Changshan Commandery Yu Jin.

sentences.zh: 使持節、柱國大將軍、大都督、少傅、彭城郡開國公侯莫陳崇。

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Pillar of the State and Grand General, Grand Commandant, Junior Tutor, Duke of Pengcheng Commandery Houmo Chenchong.
translations.idiomatic: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Pillar of the State and Grand General, Grand Commandant, Junior Tutor, Duke of Pengcheng Commandery Houmo Chenchong.

sentences.zh: 與周文帝為八柱國。

translations.literal: With Emperor Wen of Zhou they were the Eight Pillars of the State.
translations.idiomatic: With Emperor Wen of Zhou they were the Eight Pillars of the State.

sentences.zh: 使持節、大將軍、大都督、少保、廣平王元贊。

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand General, Grand Commandant, Junior Guardian, Prince of Guangping Yuan Zan.
translations.idiomatic: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand General, Grand Commandant, Junior Guardian, Prince of Guangping Yuan Zan.

sentences.zh: 使持節、大將軍、大都督、淮安王元育。

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand General, Grand Commandant, Prince of Huai'an Yuan Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand General, Grand Commandant, Prince of Huai'an Yuan Yu.

sentences.zh: 使持節、大將軍、大都督、齊王元廓。

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand General, Grand Commandant, Prince of Qi Yuan Kuo.
translations.idiomatic: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand General, Grand Commandant, Prince of Qi Yuan Kuo.

sentences.zh: 使持節、大將軍、大都督、平原郡開國公侯莫陳順。

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand General, Grand Commandant, Duke of Pingyuan Commandery Houmo Shun.
translations.idiomatic: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand General, Grand Commandant, Duke of Pingyuan Commandery Houmo Shun.

sentences.zh: 使持節、大將軍、大都督、七州諸軍事、秦州刺史、章武郡開國公宇文導。

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand General, Grand Commandant, Commander-in-Chief over seven provinces, Governor of Qin Province, Duke of Zhangwu Commandery Yuwen Dao.
translations.idiomatic: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand General, Grand Commandant, Commander-in-Chief over seven provinces, Governor of Qin Province, Duke of Zhangwu Commandery Yuwen Dao.

sentences.zh: 使持節、大將軍、大都督、雍州諸軍事、雍州刺史、高陽郡開國公達奚武。

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand General, Grand Commandant, Commander-in-Chief over Yong Province, Governor of Yong Province, Duke of Gaoyang Commandery Daxi Wu.
translations.idiomatic: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand General, Grand Commandant, Commander-in-Chief over Yong Province, Governor of Yong Province, Duke of Gaoyang Commandery Daxi Wu.

sentences.zh: 使持節、大將軍、大都督、陽平郡開國公李遠。

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand General, Grand Commandant, Duke of Yangping Commandery Li Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand General, Grand Commandant, Duke of Yangping Commandery Li Yuan.

sentences.zh: 使持節、大將軍、大都督、范陽郡開國公豆盧寧。

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand General, Grand Commandant, Duke of Fanyang Commandery Doulu Ning.
translations.idiomatic: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand General, Grand Commandant, Duke of Fanyang Commandery Doulu Ning.

sentences.zh: 使持節、大將軍、大都督、化政郡開國公宇文貴。

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand General, Grand Commandant, Duke of Huazheng Commandery Yuwen Gui.
translations.idiomatic: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand General, Grand Commandant, Duke of Huazheng Commandery Yuwen Gui.

sentences.zh: 使持節、大將軍、大都督、荊州諸軍事、荊州刺史、博陵郡開國公賀蘭祥。

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand General, Grand Commandant, Commander-in-Chief over Jing Province, Governor of Jing Province, Duke of Boling Commandery Helan Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand General, Grand Commandant, Commander-in-Chief over Jing Province, Governor of Jing Province, Duke of Boling Commandery Helan Xiang.

sentences.zh: 使持節、大將軍、大都督、陳留君開國公楊忠。

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand General, Grand Commandant, Duke of Chenliu Commandery Yang Zhong.
translations.idiomatic: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand General, Grand Commandant, Duke of Chenliu Commandery Yang Zhong.

sentences.zh: 使持節、大將軍、大都督、岐州諸軍事、岐州刺史、武威群開國公王雄。

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand General, Grand Commandant, Commander-in-Chief over Qi Province, Governor of Qi Province, Duke of Wuwei Commandery Wang Xiong.
translations.idiomatic: Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand General, Grand Commandant, Commander-in-Chief over Qi Province, Governor of Qi Province, Duke of Wuwei Commandery Wang Xiong.

sentences.zh: 是為十二大將軍。

translations.literal: These were the Twelve Grand Generals.
translations.idiomatic: These were the Twelve Grand Generals.

sentences.zh: 每大將軍督二開府，凡為二十四員，分團統領，是二十四軍。

translations.literal: Each Grand General commanded two Grand Masters of the Office, twenty-four in all, divided into regiments for command—the twenty-four armies.
translations.idiomatic: Each Grand General commanded two Grandees of the Office, twenty-four in all, divided into regiments for command—the twenty-four armies.

sentences.zh: 每一團，儀同二人。

translations.literal: Each regiment had two Masters of the Same Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Each regiment had two Masters of the Same Rank.

sentences.zh: 自相督率，不編戶貫。

translations.literal: They supervised one another and were not registered in household rolls.
translations.idiomatic: They supervised one another and were not registered in household rolls.

sentences.zh: 都十二大將軍。

translations.literal: All were under the twelve Grand Generals.
translations.idiomatic: All were under the twelve Grand Generals.

sentences.zh: 十五日上，則門欄陛戟，警晝巡夜；

translations.literal: For the first fifteen days of the month they guarded the gate, halberds at the threshold, patrolling by day and night;
translations.idiomatic: For the first fifteen days of the month they guarded the gate, halberds at the threshold, patrolling by day and night;

sentences.zh: 十五日下，則教旗習戰。

translations.literal: for the last fifteen days they drilled flags and practiced battle.
translations.idiomatic: for the last fifteen days they drilled flags and practiced battle.

sentences.zh: 無他賦役。

translations.literal: They had no other levies or corvée.
translations.idiomatic: They had no other levies or corvée.

sentences.zh: 每兵唯辦弓刀一具，月簡閱之。

translations.literal: Each soldier provided only one bow and blade; they were inspected monthly.
translations.idiomatic: Each soldier provided only one bow and blade; they were inspected monthly.

sentences.zh: 甲槊戈弩，並資官給。

translations.literal: Armor, spears, halberds, and crossbows were all supplied by the state.
translations.idiomatic: Armor, spears, halberds, and crossbows were all supplied by the state.

sentences.zh: 自大統十六年以前，十二大將軍外，念賢及王思政亦拜大將軍。

translations.literal: Before the sixteenth year of Datong, outside the twelve Grand Generals, Nian Xian and Wang Sizheng were also appointed Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: Before the sixteenth year of Datong, outside the twelve Grand Generals, Nian Xian and Wang Sizheng were also appointed Grand General.

sentences.zh: 然賢作牧隴右，思政出鎮河南，並不在領兵之限。

translations.literal: But Xian governed Longyou and Sizheng garrisoned Henan, neither within the limit of leading troops.
translations.idiomatic: But Xian governed Longyou and Sizheng garrisoned Henan, neither within the limit of leading troops.

sentences.zh: 此後功臣位至柱國及大將軍者眾矣，不限此秩，無所統御。

translations.literal: After this many meritorious ministers reached Pillar of the State and Grand General without limit to this rank and without command.
translations.idiomatic: After this many meritorious ministers reached Pillar of the State and Grand General without limit to this rank and without command.

sentences.zh: 六柱國、十二大將軍之後，有以位次嗣掌其事者，而德望素在諸公之下，並不得預於此例。

translations.literal: After the Six Pillars of the State and Twelve Grand Generals, some succeeded to these posts by rank, but because their virtue and reputation had always been below the great lords, none could participate in this precedent.
